={"contents":[{"parts":[{"fileData":{"fileUri":"{{ $json.source_url }}"},"videoMetadata":{"fps":0.2}},{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a senior content strategist. Watch this video end to end and mine it for content raw material.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these keys. No markdown fences and no prose.

title: the actual video title or a faithful short title
core_thesis: the single central argument of this video in one sentence
key_moments: an array of objects, each with ts in HH:MM:SS format, moment describing what is said, and why_it_matters
quotable_lines: an array of exact or lightly cleaned quotable sentences from the video
audience_takeaways: an array of concrete things a viewer can now do or believe
contrarian_angle: the most counterintuitive or debate worthy claim in the video
data_points: an array of any numbers, stats, figures or named examples mentioned
detected_tone: a short description of how the speaker actually talks

RULES
key_moments must have 5 to 7 entries with REAL timestamps taken from the video.
quotable_lines must have exactly 5 entries.
audience_takeaways must have exactly 3 entries.
data_points can have up to 5 entries. Use an empty array if the video has none.
Never invent a fact that is not in the video.
Return raw JSON only.

CONTEXT
Creator: " + ($json.creator_name || "") + "
Target audience: " + ($json.audience || "") + "
Extra angle the creator wants: " + ($json.angle_notes || "")) }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.3,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json","mediaResolution":"MEDIA_RESOLUTION_LOW"}}

" + ($json.data_text || "") + "

TASK
Write exactly 3 short form video scripts, each 30 to 60 seconds when read aloud. Each script must be built on a DIFFERENT key moment from the source.

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. The object has one key called scripts holding an array. Each array entry has these keys: title, hook, script, on_screen_text, cta, source_timestamp.

title is an internal name for the script
hook is the first 3 seconds of spoken words and must stop the scroll
script is the full spoken script including the hook
on_screen_text is pipe separated on screen captions in the order they appear
cta is a one line call to action
source_timestamp is the HH:MM:SS of the key moment this is built on

RULES
Exactly 3 scripts.
The hook must never be a question that can be answered with a no.
No em-dashes anywhere.
Every script must reference something concrete from the source. Never write generic advice.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.85,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

      "hook": "I stopped selling AI features last month. My revenue tripled.",
      "body": "I used to pitch 'AI agents' and 'Claude integrations' to local businesses. I sounded like every other agency. I got nowhere. Then I changed my pitch. I stopped selling code and started selling outcomes. I asked business owners one question: Do you want more customers, higher margins, or lower costs? I spent three weeks running free audits for my network. No fancy website. No niche. Just solving a specific constraint for a local logistics firm. I built a workflow that saved them 15 hours of manual data entry every week. I charged them 40,000 rupees for the setup. They paid it immediately. Builders sell features. Partners sell outcomes. Stop acting like a vendor. Start acting like an operator who happens to use AI. Build. Automate. Scale.",

Audit: Offer free, 30-minute deep dives for your friends or past colleagues. Get pattern recognition.\n\n3. Project: Once you find a repeat problem, turn it into a productized service. Ship it before Monday.",

    },

      "format": "contrarian",

      "hashtags": "#FounderLife #AI #Strategy #Bootstrapping",
      "cta": "Do you agree or should beginners pick a niche immediately?",
      "source_timestamp": "10:17:00"
    },
    {
      "format": "data",
      "hook": "86 percent of CEOs think their teams are ready for AI. Only 25 percent of workers actually use it.",
      "body": "There is a massive gap between executive intent and actual execution. This is where you come in. Most AI projects fail because they never leave the proof of concept phase. Only 13 percent of projects make it to real production. Business owners do not care about your prompt engineering skills. They care about that 13 percent success rate. If you can bridge that gap and turn a shaky demo into a production-ready workflow, you win. AI-enabled freelancers are currently earning 40 percent more per hour than their peers. That premium is real. It is not because they are smarter. It is because they deliver measurable business outcomes. Stop playing with tools. Start delivering production code.",
      "hashtags": "#FutureOfWork #AI #TechTrends #Productivity",
      "cta": "Are you focusing on POCs or production-ready workflows?",
      "source_timestamp": "12:43:00"
    },
    {
      "format": "question",
      "hook": "Do you have a scoping problem or a lead problem?",
      "body": "Most founders think they have a lead problem. They have a scoping problem. When a client says they want an AI chatbot, they actually want to reduce support costs. If you build a chatbot that doesn't save them money, you lose. I use the four-blank template for every project. I define the specific metric, the current baseline, the target outcome, and the deadline. If I cannot fill those blanks, I do not write a single line of code. It saves me from spending weeks on projects that don't matter. It forces the client to be honest about their goals. It turns a vague request into a professional contract. Stop rushing for your first yes. Race to your first ten nos instead.",
      "hashtags": "#Sales #AIBuilder #ConsultantLife #Growth",
      "cta": "How do you scope your projects to ensure they provide real value?",
      "source_timestamp": "17:44:00"
    }
  ]
}
